title: crepidomanes acutum
intro: Crepidomanes acutum, commonly known as the needle fern, is a species of epiphytic fern native to Southeast Asia, characterized by its slender and elongated fronds. This plant is prized for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The therapeutic actions of Crepidomanes acutum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress, making it a valuable natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified through various phytochemical analyses.
